I couldn't find an Alberta figure. The only Statistics Canada table on poverty by disability status is 11-10-0090-01, and it covers Canada only, with no provincial breakdown. Table 11-10-0087-01 does have provinces, but it measures income distribution, not poverty rates.

For Canada, the poverty rate for persons with disabilities aged 15 and over was 12.6% in 2024. That uses the Market Basket Measure, 2023 base. Persons without disabilities had a rate of 8.4%. The Canada estimates exclude the territories.

- **Persons with disabilities:** 12.6% in 2024 (v1793292452). The rate was 12.9% in 2022 and 12.8% in 2023.
- **Persons without disabilities:** 8.4% in 2024 (v1793292497). The rate was 7.7% in 2022 and 8.3% in 2023.

Source: Statistics Canada, Table 11-10-0090-01, Canadian Income Survey, reference years 2022–2024. The data quality rating is B (very good).

An Alberta estimate may exist in a custom tabulation or a Statistics Canada release that isn't in this dataset. I haven't checked those.

I couldn't find an Alberta figure. The table I checked, 11-10-0090-01 (Poverty and low-income statistics by disability status), covers Canada only and has no provincial breakdown. It also excludes the territories. I found no other table in this database that gives poverty rates by disability status for Alberta. The provincial disability tables I found (11-10-0087-01 and 13-10-0379-01) report income, not poverty rates.

**National figure, for reference:** 12.6% of persons aged 15 and over with disabilities were in poverty in 2024. This uses the Market Basket Measure (2023 base). The source is Table 11-10-0090-01, vector v1793292452. The data quality grade is B (very good). The figure was 12.9% in 2022 and 12.8% in 2023.

This is a national number and should not be read as Alberta's rate.

I couldn't find an Alberta poverty rate for people with disabilities in the data I can access.

The relevant table is 11-10-0090-01, "Poverty and low-income statistics by disability status" (Canadian Income Survey). It is published for Canada only, with no provincial breakdown. Table 11-10-0087-01 does have provincial data by disability status, but it covers income distribution, not poverty rates. A search for disability and low income in Alberta returned nothing.

**National figure (Canada, excluding the territories):**
- Persons aged 15 and over with disabilities were in poverty at a rate of **12.6% in 2024**. The measure is the Market Basket Measure, 2023 base. The source is table 11-10-0090-01, vector v1793292452, data quality B (very good).
- The rate for persons without disabilities was 8.4% in 2024 (v1793292497).
- The rate for persons with disabilities was 12.9% in 2022 and 12.8% in 2023.

I can't say how Alberta compares with this national rate. A provincial estimate might be available as a custom tabulation from Statistics Canada, but I haven't checked.
